commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: The ignorance of loving and pursuing a woman who is another man’s property isn’t found in those on earth who have studied the books of righteousness and of wealth. Those who study the books of pleasure, and look to pleasure alone, even give this wicked conduct a name, so he names only the two. Those with this folly have neither righteousness nor wealth.
